knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
cran_packages <- c("dplyr","forcats","ggplot2","knitr","pROC","purrr","readr","stringr","tibble","tidyr","rmarkdown")
bioc_packages <- c("DESeq2")
missing_cran <- cran_packages[!vapply(cran_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
missing_bioc <- bioc_packages[!vapply(bioc_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing_cran) > 0) stop("Missing CRAN package(s): ", paste(missing_cran, collapse = ", "))
if (length(missing_bioc) > 0) stop("Missing Bioconductor package(s): ", paste(missing_bioc, collapse = ", "))

library(DESeq2); library(dplyr); library(forcats); library(ggplot2); library(knitr)
library(pROC); library(purrr); library(readr); library(stringr); library(tibble); library(tidyr)
has_pheatmap <- requireNamespace("pheatmap", quietly = TRUE)
has_ggrepel <- requireNamespace("ggrepel", quietly = TRUE)
dir.create(params$output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
plot_dir <- file.path(params$output_dir, "plots")
deg_dir <- file.path(params$output_dir, "deg_outputs")
dir.create(plot_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(deg_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

safe_auc <- function(data, response_col, predictor_col, reference_level, comparison_level, direction = "auto",
                     min_n_per_group = params$min_n_per_group_auc) {
  y <- as.character(data[[response_col]])
  x <- data[[predictor_col]]
  ok <- !is.na(y) & !is.na(x)
  y <- y[ok]; x <- x[ok]
  if (sum(y == reference_level) < min_n_per_group || sum(y == comparison_level) < min_n_per_group) return(NA_real_)
  if (!all(c(reference_level, comparison_level) %in% y) || length(unique(y)) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(round(pROC::auc(factor(y, levels = c(reference_level, comparison_level)), x,
                             levels = c(reference_level, comparison_level), direction = direction, quiet = TRUE), 2))
}

1 Purpose

This workflow converts the uploaded NGS / DESeq2 script into an HTML-ready R Markdown workflow.

Masking rules: - signature formulas are run in hidden chunks; - signature names and component genes are not shown in visible report text; - visible score outputs use Score 1 to Score 5; - genome-wide DESeq2 outputs preserve original gene symbols; - AUC is returned as NA when either group has fewer than 3 non-missing samples.

2 Import raw NGS counts

if (!file.exists(params$raw_counts_file)) stop("Missing raw counts file: ", params$raw_counts_file)
# Use check.names = FALSE so dashes in sample names (e.g. Series1_NHBE_SARS-CoV-2_1,
# Series6_A549-ACE2_Mock_1) are preserved. Default read.csv() converts dashes to dots
# via make.names(), which then mismatches `unique_id` (which has dashes) and causes the
# downstream `filter(unique_id %in% colnames(count_matrix))` to silently drop every
# SARS-CoV-2 / A549-ACE2 sample.
raw_counts <- read.csv(params$raw_counts_file, sep = "\t", check.names = FALSE)
# First column holds gene symbols; its header is blank in the TSV. Rename it.
names(raw_counts)[1] <- "gene_symbol"
count_matrix <- raw_counts %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene_symbol), gene_symbol != "") %>%
  distinct(gene_symbol, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_symbol") %>%
  as.matrix()
storage.mode(count_matrix) <- "integer"
tibble(n_genes = nrow(count_matrix), n_samples = ncol(count_matrix))

3 Raw-count distribution

boxplot_df <- as.data.frame(log2(count_matrix + 1)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_symbol") %>%
  pivot_longer(-gene_symbol, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "log2_count")
p_raw <- ggplot(boxplot_df, aes(sample_id, log2_count)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
  labs(title = "Raw count distribution", x = "Samples", y = "log2(raw count + 1)")
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "GSE147507_raw_count_distribution.png"), p_raw, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
p_raw

4 Import corrected metadata

if (!file.exists(params$metadata_file)) stop("Missing metadata file: ", params$metadata_file)
meta_raw <- read.csv(params$metadata_file)
required_cols <- c("geo_accession","X","source_name_ch1","characteristics_ch1","characteristics_ch1.2",
                   "characteristics_ch1.3","characteristics_ch1.4","characteristics_ch1.5","description1")
miss <- setdiff(required_cols, names(meta_raw))
if (length(miss) > 0) stop("Missing metadata columns: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))

sample_metadata <- tibble(
  geo_accession = meta_raw$geo_accession,
  unique_id = str_replace_all(meta_raw$X, "\\.", "-"),
  source_name = meta_raw$source_name_ch1,
  cell_line = str_remove(meta_raw$characteristics_ch1, regex("^cell line: ", ignore_case = TRUE)),
  cell_type = meta_raw$characteristics_ch1.2 %>% str_remove(regex("^cell type: ", ignore_case = TRUE)) %>% str_remove(regex("^tissue/", ignore_case = TRUE)),
  treatment = meta_raw$characteristics_ch1.3 %>% str_remove(regex("^treatment: ", ignore_case = TRUE)) %>% str_remove(regex("^subject status: ", ignore_case = TRUE)),
  strain = str_remove(meta_raw$characteristics_ch1.4, regex("^strain: ", ignore_case = TRUE)),
  time_point = meta_raw$characteristics_ch1.5,
  description = meta_raw$description1
) %>%
  mutate(
    time_point = time_point %>%
      str_remove(regex("^time point: ", ignore_case = TRUE)) %>%
      str_remove(regex("^time after treatment: ", ignore_case = TRUE)) %>%
      str_replace(" hours", "") %>% str_replace("hrs after treatment", "") %>% str_trim(),
    time_point = if_else(time_point == "", NA_character_, paste0(time_point, "hr")),
    unique_id_mod = unique_id %>% str_remove("_1$") %>% str_remove("_2$") %>% str_remove("_3$") %>% str_remove("_4$"),
    group_label = paste(unique_id_mod, time_point, sep = "_") %>%
      str_replace("Series15_HealthyLungBiopsy_", "Series15_HealthyLungBiopsy") %>%
      str_replace("Series15_COVID19Lung_", "Series15_COVID19Lung") %>%
      str_replace("Series9_NHBE_IFNB_6h_6hr", "Series9_NHBE_IFNB_6hr") %>%
      str_replace("Series9_NHBE_IFNB2h_12hr", "Series9_NHBE_IFNB_12hr") %>%
      str_replace("Series9_NHBE_IFNBh_4hr", "Series9_NHBE_IFNB_4hr"),
    series = str_extract(unique_id, "^Series[0-9]+"),
    treatment_status = case_when(
      str_detect(group_label, regex("Mock", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Mock",
      str_detect(cell_line, regex("HealthyLungBiopsy", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Healthy",
      TRUE ~ "Infected"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(unique_id %in% colnames(count_matrix)) %>%
  arrange(match(unique_id, colnames(count_matrix)))

count_matrix <- count_matrix[, sample_metadata$unique_id, drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(identical(sample_metadata$unique_id, colnames(count_matrix)))
sample_metadata %>% count(series, cell_line, treatment_status)

5 DESeq2 normalization

dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = count_matrix, colData = as.data.frame(sample_metadata), design = ~ group_label)
dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
normalized_counts <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)
vsd <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds, blind = TRUE)
vsd_matrix <- assay(vsd)

6 Hidden masked score calculation

The calculations are intentionally hidden from the HTML. Visible outputs use masked labels only.

7 Masked score summary and AUC

signature_long %>%
  group_by(signature_label, series, treatment_status) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(!is.na(score_value)), median = median(score_value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(series, signature_label)
score_auc_by_series <- signature_long %>%
  filter(treatment_status %in% c("Mock","Infected")) %>%
  group_by(series, signature_label, signature_id) %>%
  group_modify(~ tibble(
    auc = safe_auc(.x, "treatment_status", "score_value", "Mock", "Infected"),
    n_mock = sum(.x$treatment_status == "Mock" & !is.na(.x$score_value)),
    n_infected = sum(.x$treatment_status == "Infected" & !is.na(.x$score_value))
  )) %>%
  ungroup()
write_csv(score_auc_by_series, file.path(params$output_dir, "GSE147507_masked_score_auc_by_series.csv"))
score_auc_by_series

8 Masked score plots

score_plot_objects <- list()
for (sid in sort(unique(signature_long$series))) {
  dat <- filter(signature_long, series == sid)
  if (nrow(dat) == 0) next
  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(group_label, score_value, shape = treatment_status)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = .25), alpha = .75) +
    facet_grid(signature_label ~ ., scales = "free_y") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    labs(title = paste0(sid, ": masked scores"), x = "", y = "Masked score", shape = "Treatment")
  score_plot_objects[[sid]] <- p
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, paste0("GSE147507_", sid, "_masked_scores.png")), p, width = 11, height = 8, dpi = 300)
}

9 DESeq2 differential expression with original gene names

contrast_plan <- tibble(
  comparison_id = c("Series1_NHBE", "Series2_A549", "Series5_A549", "Series6_A549_ACE2", "Series7_Calu3"),
  reference_group = c("Series1_NHBE_Mock_24hr", "Series2_A549_Mock_24hr", "Series5_A549_Mock_24hr", "Series6_A549-ACE2_Mock_24hr", "Series7_Calu3_Mock_24hr"),
  comparison_group = c("Series1_NHBE_SARS-CoV-2_24hr", "Series2_A549_SARS-CoV-2_24hr", "Series5_A549_SARS-CoV-2_24hr", "Series6_A549-ACE2_SARS-CoV-2_24hr", "Series7_Calu3_SARS-CoV-2_24hr")
) %>%
  # Safe to re-enable now that read.csv preserves dashes (see import-counts chunk).
  filter(reference_group %in% sample_metadata$group_label,
         comparison_group %in% sample_metadata$group_label)

if (nrow(contrast_plan) == 0) stop("contrast_plan is empty: no reference/comparison groups matched sample_metadata$group_label")

res_list <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(contrast_plan))) {
  cp <- contrast_plan[i, ]
  keep <- sample_metadata$group_label %in% c(cp$reference_group, cp$comparison_group)
  cm <- count_matrix[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  md <- sample_metadata[keep, , drop = FALSE] %>% mutate(contrast_group = factor(if_else(group_label == cp$comparison_group, "Comparison", "Reference"), levels = c("Reference", "Comparison")))
  if (sum(md$contrast_group == "Reference") < 2 || sum(md$contrast_group == "Comparison") < 2) next
  dds_i <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = cm, colData = as.data.frame(md), design = ~ contrast_group)
  dds_i <- DESeq(dds_i, quiet = TRUE)
  res_i <- as.data.frame(results(dds_i, contrast = c("contrast_group", "Comparison", "Reference"))) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene_symbol") %>% as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(comparison_id = cp$comparison_id, comparison_group = cp$comparison_group, reference_group = cp$reference_group,
           minus_log10_padj = -log10(padj),
           significance_class = case_when(padj < .05 & log2FoldChange > 1 ~ "Higher in comparison",
                                          padj < .05 & log2FoldChange < -1 ~ "Higher in reference",
                                          TRUE ~ "Not significant"))
  res_list[[cp$comparison_id]] <- res_i
}
deseq_results <- bind_rows(res_list)
if (nrow(deseq_results) == 0) stop("res_list is empty: no contrasts had enough samples to fit DESeq2")
write_csv(deseq_results, file.path(deg_dir, "GSE147507_DESeq2_results_original_gene_names.csv"))
deseq_results %>% count(comparison_id, significance_class)

10 DESeq2 volcano and MA plots

volcano_plot_objects <- list(); ma_plot_objects <- list()
for (cid in unique(deseq_results$comparison_id)) {
  dat <- filter(deseq_results, comparison_id == cid) %>%
    mutate(display_label = if_else(padj < .05 & abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1, gene_symbol, NA_character_))
  p_vol <- ggplot(dat, aes(log2FoldChange, minus_log10_padj)) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = significance_class), alpha = .7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1,1), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(.05), linetype = "dashed") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    labs(title = paste0("Volcano plot: ", cid), x = "log2 fold-change", y = "-log10 adjusted P value", shape = "Class")
  if (has_ggrepel) {
    p_vol <- p_vol + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = filter(dat, !is.na(display_label)) %>% arrange(padj) %>% slice_head(n = 20),
                                              aes(label = display_label), size = 3, max.overlaps = 20)
  }
  volcano_plot_objects[[cid]] <- p_vol
  ggsave(file.path(deg_dir, paste0("GSE147507_volcano_", cid, "_original_gene_names.png")), p_vol, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)

  p_ma <- ggplot(dat, aes(baseMean, log2FoldChange)) +
    geom_point(aes(shape = significance_class), alpha = .7) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1,0,1), linetype = c("dashed","solid","dashed")) +
    scale_x_log10() + theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    labs(title = paste0("MA plot: ", cid), x = "baseMean", y = "log2 fold-change", shape = "Class")
  ma_plot_objects[[cid]] <- p_ma
  ggsave(file.path(deg_dir, paste0("GSE147507_MA_", cid, "_original_gene_names.png")), p_ma, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
}

11 PCA and heatmaps with original gene names

pca <- prcomp(t(vsd_matrix), center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
pca_var <- round(100 * (pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)), 1)
pca_scores <- as_tibble(pca$x[,1:2], rownames = "unique_id") %>% left_join(sample_metadata, by = "unique_id")
p_pca <- ggplot(pca_scores, aes(PC1, PC2, shape = treatment_status)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = .85) + facet_wrap(~ series, scales = "free") + theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  labs(title = "PCA of variance-stabilized counts", x = paste0("PC1 (", pca_var[1], "%)"), y = paste0("PC2 (", pca_var[2], "%)"), shape = "Treatment")
ggsave(file.path(deg_dir, "GSE147507_PCA_vst_original_gene_names.png"), p_pca, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
p_pca

heatmap_files <- character(0)

for (cid in unique(deseq_results$comparison_id)) {
  top_genes <- filter(deseq_results, comparison_id == cid, !is.na(padj)) %>% arrange(padj, desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) %>% slice_head(n = 50) %>% pull(gene_symbol)
  cp <- filter(contrast_plan, comparison_id == cid)
  keep <- sample_metadata$group_label %in% c(cp$reference_group, cp$comparison_group)
  if (length(top_genes) < 2 || sum(keep) < 2) next
  hm <- vsd_matrix[top_genes, keep, drop = FALSE]
  hm <- t(scale(t(hm))); hm[!is.finite(hm)] <- 0
  ann <- as.data.frame(sample_metadata[keep, c("group_label","treatment_status","series")])
  rownames(ann) <- sample_metadata$unique_id[keep]
  outfile <- file.path(deg_dir, paste0("GSE147507_heatmap_top_DESeq2_", cid, "_original_gene_names.png"))
  if (has_pheatmap) {
    png(outfile, width = 2200, height = 2600, res = 300)
    pheatmap::pheatmap(hm, annotation_col = ann, show_colnames = FALSE, show_rownames = TRUE, fontsize_row = 6, main = paste0("Top DESeq2 genes: ", cid))
    dev.off()
  }
  heatmap_files <- c(heatmap_files, outfile)
}

if (length(heatmap_files) > 0) knitr::include_graphics(heatmap_files[1])

pca <- prcomp(t(vsd_matrix), center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
pca_var <- round(100 * (pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)), 1)
pca_scores <- as_tibble(pca$x[,1:2], rownames = "unique_id") %>% left_join(sample_metadata, by = "unique_id")
p_pca <- ggplot(pca_scores, aes(PC1, PC2, shape = treatment_status)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = .85) + facet_wrap(~ series, scales = "free") + theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  labs(title = "PCA of variance-stabilized counts", x = paste0("PC1 (", pca_var[1], "%)"), y = paste0("PC2 (", pca_var[2], "%)"), shape = "Treatment")
ggsave(file.path(deg_dir, "GSE147507_PCA_vst_original_gene_names.png"), p_pca, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300)
p_pca
